```{python}
# | label: compile-time-report
# | cache: false
# | echo: false

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import time

doc_name = "methods_validation_multi_epoch_bayesian.qmd"
project_dir = Path(os.environ.get("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR", Path.cwd()))
compile_log = project_dir / "_output" / "compile_times.json"
compile_log.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

duration_seconds = time.perf_counter() - __compile_start
timestamp = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

try:
    data = json.loads(compile_log.read_text()) if compile_log.exists() else {}
except Exception:
    data = {}

data[doc_name] = {"duration_seconds": duration_seconds, "timestamp": timestamp}
compile_log.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, sort_keys=True))

print(f"Render duration (non-cached): {duration_seconds:.2f}s")
```
